payout_quote: Earn $25 every time you refer a friend to CommStar Credit Union. The more you refer, the more you earn, up to $500. Plus, your friends will earn $25 when they open an eligible account.
steps: Be an existing CommStar (Community Star) Credit Union member
Tell friends/family to enter your name in the Member Referral box when opening an account online (or give them a Member Referral card)
Friend opens a qualifying share and checking account, enrolls in eStatements and Online Banking, and sets up recurring direct deposit of at least $500/month; accounts stay open 90+ days
You receive $25 deposited into your existing CommStar checking account within 30 days of the friend meeting all requirements
catches: Friend bar is high: $500/month recurring direct deposit, eStatements, online banking, accounts open 90 days
Friend must name you in the Member Referral box at account opening
Rewards issued within 30 days after all requirements are satisfied
Membership limited to those who live, work, worship, or attend school in Lorain County (per official referral materials)
biggest_catch: Only $25 a pop — and your friend must set up a $500/month recurring direct deposit and keep the account open 90 days before anyone gets paid.
eligibility: Existing CommStar Credit Union members; referred friends must be membership-eligible new members
timing: Rewards issued within 30 days after the referred member satisfies all requirements (90-day account seasoning)
